The solution focuses on combining human-like understanding with automated responses, aiming to improve overall customer engagement. Cresta’s approach highlights the potential of AI-driven tools in transforming CX operations.

items.title: How we made claude.ai 3x faster in two weeks
items.content: Inside our performance sprint: the benchmarks Claude built, the loop each Slack thread ran, and the guardrails that let us ship 3,000 changes safely.
items.contentSnippet: Inside our performance sprint: the benchmarks Claude built, the loop each Slack thread ran, and the guardrails that let us ship 3,000 changes safely.

summaries.zh: Claude.ai在两周内通过性能冲刺将速度提升三倍。团队通过构建基准测试、优化Slack线程循环，并设立安全护栏，成功部署了3000次变更。这一过程展示了高效的技术迭代和风险控制。
summaries.en: Claude.ai achieved a 3x speed improvement in just two weeks through a focused performance sprint. The process involved benchmarking Claude's performance, optimizing the Slack thread loop, and implementing guardrails to safely deploy 3,000 changes. The initiative successfully enhanced efficiency while ensuring stability.
